tasks.title: Define public API types, ports and Idempotency Key
tasks.dod: Unit tests prove the Idempotency Key is identical across re-executions and replies carry correlation id and Request Key unchanged.

tasks.title: Implement lane share calculator (weights, 5% minimum, idle redistribution)
tasks.dod: Unit tests show lane shares follow weights, no busy lane drops below 5%, and idle shares are redistributed.

tasks.title: Add configuration properties and startup validation
tasks.dod: A misconfigured worker (conflicting timings, weight ≤ 0, no Handler, no identity) refuses to start with a message naming the conflict.

tasks.title: Implement the Redis-compatible AllowanceStore adapter
tasks.dod: Two clients on one Redis-compatible store never take more than the Rate Budget (× 1.05) in a sliding second, and an unreachable store raises the fail-closed exception.

tasks.title: Implement the Kafka RequestLanes adapter with stable worker identity
tasks.dod: A worker restarted with the same identity within 45 s regains its lanes and the other worker is never reassigned.

tasks.title: Implement the transactional Kafka ReplySink
tasks.dod: Replies and request positions commit atomically; a re-run Cycle never yields a second committed reply to a committed-only reader.

tasks.title: Implement worker pause and stall state machine
tasks.dod: With a fake clock, a worker with pending work and no commit for 60 s reports stalled, an idle or paused worker never does.

tasks.title: Implement intake: reserve allowance, weighted fetch, return unused, fail closed
tasks.dod: Intake never fetches more than the reserved allowance, returns unused units, spends none on malformed input and fails closed when the store is unreachable.

tasks.title: Implement Handler execution: virtual threads, timeout, cancellation, Error Replies
tasks.dod: A failing or slow Handler yields exactly one Error Reply (failure or timeout), is never re-run, and no request outlives the Cycle deadline.

tasks.title: Add per-Request-Key ordering inside a lane
tasks.dod: Requests with the same Request Key in a lane run in arrival order while other keys run in parallel.

tasks.title: Assemble the Cycle commit and turn undeliverable replies into Error Replies
tasks.dod: A reply that cannot be delivered is replaced by an Error Reply in the same commit, other requests are unaffected and no Handler re-runs.

tasks.title: Add commit retry, destination pause and resume
tasks.dod: Failed commits retry with the same results, an unavailable or forbidden destination pauses the worker in its group, and recovery re-commits without re-running Handlers.

tasks.title: Implement the Cycle loop that ties intake, execution and commit together
tasks.dod: With fake ports a request travels through intake, Handler and commit and the reply carries the request correlation id.

tasks.title: Implement the Micrometer WorkerMetrics adapter
tasks.dod: Consistency Lag is recorded per lane for every committed reply, implausible samples are flagged and excluded.

tasks.title: Wire the Spring Boot auto-configuration and startup permission check
tasks.dod: A Handler bean plus configuration produces a running worker, and a missing destination permission pauses it instead of crashing it.

tasks.title: Add the failure-scenario test suite
tasks.dod: Failure scenarios (kill, failed commit, destination down, store down, degraded downstream) all end with 0 lost and 0 duplicated committed replies.

tasks.title: Add rollout, weight-accuracy and throughput tests
tasks.dod: Rolling restart shows 0 reassignments, accepted rate stays within budget × 1.05, lanes stay within ±10 points, throughput is measured against 2,000 requests/s.

tasks.title: Write the starter guide and operator runbook
tasks.dod: The guide states committed-reads-only, same-key-one-lane, cooperative cancellation next to the Idempotency Key note, and the stranded-lane runbook.
